execution.malformed_not_in_execution_status: codec malformed/blocked never appear as Report.status

failure.incomplete: incompleteObligation.{name} or null when only outstanding informational

report_field_rules.judgments: exactly the eight families, each with family, outcome, claimed, match
report_field_rules.world: always a complete |domains|×|parties|×|assets| State plus full store (32 cells only for the current 2×4×4 universe). Kernel/interface/authority/configuration refusal retains the pre-world. Policy refusal after a successful recomputed execution (observationMismatch, incompleteObligation after kernel ok) retains the recomputed post-world. Sequential refusal-prefix retains Sequence.advance's world (successful prefix, inert suffix).
report_field_rules.receipt: null iff this command has no successful invoke/issue/revoke. Successful invoke: {tag:invoked, request, evaluated}. Successful issue: {tag:issued, id}, never null. Successful revoke: {tag:revoked, id}, never null. Kernel/interface/authority/configuration refusal: null. Policy refusal after successful execution retains the successful command receipt. composition-run uses the last successful prefix receipt, or null if no successful step.
report_field_rules.outputs: list, empty when no successful invoke snapshots
report_field_rules.events: list of sequential events; empty in typed-execute mode
report_field_rules.nextIndex: Nat; typed-execute uses 0; composition-run uses cursor.nextIndex
report_field_rules.cursorFailure: null or {index, step (null|Step), reason}; startCursor invalid catalog uses index 0, step null, reason configuration
report_field_rules.assumptions: object mapping all six classes to present|missing
report_field_rules.outstanding: list of informational families not discharged
report_field_rules.source_pin: object always present in execution reports
report_field_rules.audit_roots: list always present in execution reports

failure_path.kernel_payload: Typed.Refusal constructor plus EvalFailure when evaluation
failure_path.interface_payload: InterfaceFailure constructor plus EvalFailure when resolution
failure_path.refused_prefix: world/store/outputs/events/nextIndex equal the cursor immediately before the failing step; later steps inert and absent from events

judgment_outcome.false: recomputed predicate fails at this family
judgment_outcome.not_reached: short-circuit stopped before this family's entrypoint
judgment_outcome.not_applicable: this command kind never runs that family (issue/revoke typeCorrect/footprintCorrect/accountingCorrect; typed-execute compositionCompatible; codec-only)

stage_order_typed_execute: evaluation.template.evaluate (prior class; not a family-false unless Args.check)
staged_family_aggregation.combine_one_command: Family F is false if any reached F-stage failed. Family F is not_reached if zero F-stages were reached. Family F is not_applicable if the command kind never has F. Family F is true if at least one F-stage was reached, every reached F-stage succeeded, and unreached later F-stages are not evaluated merely to fill an outcome.
staged_family_aggregation.combine_run: Walk attempts in order. A later inert suffix is not evaluated. Family F is false if any reached attempt's F is false. Successful-prefix true does not justify a later failed attempt's conjunct (F49 insufficientFunds makes accountingCorrect false). compositionCompatible remains true when catalog/run machinery ran and the failure is a kernel family.
staged_family_aggregation.insufficientFunds_family: accountingCorrect (nonnegative post-balance conjunct). Do not call accountingOK after that failure.
staged_family_aggregation.evaluation_missingObservation_family: prior class after invoke; typeCorrect is Args.check (true if that passed); authorityCorrect true if invoke passed; footprint/accounting not_reached

short_circuit.do_not_call_Args.check_before_unknownOpe: F30 remains kernel.unknownOperation; typeCorrect outcome is not_reached

truth_table_complete_for_increment.accepted: decode ok, unsupported null, required reached families outcome true, six assumption classes present, source_pin matches delivered identity records, no observationMismatch
truth_table_complete_for_increment.complete_refused: decode ok, unsupported null, observed FailurePath equals entrypoint error, families before the failure true, failing family false or the failure is a prior class, later not_reached; this IS a complete checked report, not an accepted module
truth_table_complete_for_increment.incomplete: missing required assumption class, or require_library_discharge/require_invariant_discharge set without recorded compiler check, or missing source_pin/audit_roots fields
truth_table_complete_for_increment.library_and_source_refinement: informational outstanding by default; never outcome true without recorded compiler check; do not make complete_for_increment false merely by being listed
truth_table_complete_for_increment.prop_invariants: outstanding proof; not executable; not complete-by-that-field

environment_authenticity: named sixth class; not subsumed by observation-truth. observation-truth is value correctness of delivered observations; environment-authenticity is that the environment map itself is the adapter-supplied function identity
reportEq: execution Reports only; codec and audit use their own equality; mixed-mode comparison is a planning error
uniqueness_policy: JSON/registry duplicate ids are decode uniqueness failures; catalog component-id duplicates decode successfully then validateCatalog is false (F08 configuration). Those are distinct boundaries.
